purpose: Resolve composition knowledge dispute between legacy factory AI notes and MIP Gemini research notes. Neither source is currently authoritative — both are AI-generated. Authoritative external verification is required before any guest-facing composition knowledge changes.

tier1.label: PRIMARY — Use first. Treat as authoritative.
examples: Official Mugler press kit or brand documentation
L'Oréal Group / Mugler official brand records
Official launch materials or fragrance brief
tier1.policy: Findings from Tier 1 sources are treated as authoritative unless two Tier 1 sources explicitly contradict each other — in which case record both and classify as official-disagreement.

tier2.label: STRONG SECONDARY — Use when Tier 1 is unavailable or incomplete.
examples: Fragrantica database (fragrantica.com) — widely referenced fragrance database
Basenotes database (basenotes.net) — established fragrance community reference
Established fragrance publications and industry databases
Perfumer attribution documentation from recognized sources
tier2.policy: Tier 2 findings are NOT equivalent to Tier 1. If Tier 1 and Tier 2 conflict, record both — do not silently resolve. Classify as database-disagreement or official-disagreement.

tier3.label: SUPPORTING ONLY — Do not treat as authoritative.
examples: Retailer product descriptions (Sephora, Boots, Woolworths Beauty, etc.)
tier3.policy: Tier 3 findings are contextual only. Record them if they corroborate higher-tier findings, but do not rely on them to resolve conflicts between Tier 1/2 sources.

evidenceCaptureContract.description: Each external finding must be recorded using this schema. Do not record only a final merged answer. Preserve each source finding separately. Record conflicting sources without silently resolving them. The founder reviews all recorded conflicts before any knowledge decision is made.

fieldDefinitions.sourceType: string — one of: official-brand | strong-secondary | supporting-only
fieldDefinitions.sourceName: string — human-readable name of the source (e.g. 'Mugler official product page', 'Fragrantica')
fieldDefinitions.sourceReference: string — URL, page number, document name, or other specific locator
fieldDefinitions.accessedAt: string — ISO 8601 date when the source was consulted (e.g. '2026-08-10')
fieldDefinitions.field: string — which research question this answers (e.g. 'notes.top', 'family', 'launchYear')
fieldDefinitions.observedValue: string or array — verbatim value as observed in the source; do not normalize or translate
fieldDefinitions.confidence: string — one of: authoritative | high | medium | low
fieldDefinitions.notes: string — optional qualifying information: regional variants, marketing vs. technical terminology, conflict description, reformulation note

conflictPolicy.instruction: If two sources disagree, record both entries. Do not silently choose one.
conflictTypes: official-disagreement — two official brand sources list different values
regional-naming-difference — same ingredient named differently in different markets
database-disagreement — reference databases list different values
researcher-interpretation — analyst or writer interprets source differently
reformulation-variant — fragrance was reformulated; older and newer versions have different notes
conflictPolicy.resolution: The founder makes the final resolution decision after reviewing all recorded conflicts. Claude Code does not resolve conflicts autonomously.

exclusions.performanceClaims: Do not attempt to convert external longevity, sillage, or intensity claims into institutional guest-facing promises. If researching performance, treat findings as contextual evidence only. Maison policy: no longevity or intensity promises.
exclusions.editorialFields: Do not research: subtitle (Radiant Bloom), vibe classifications (Sensual, Romantic, Confident, Elegant, Sophisticated), signatureStyle, or recommendedFor persona language. These are Maison editorial classifications — not external fact claims — and are not subject to authoritative research.
exclusions.aiSubstitution: The following are not acceptable substitutes for authoritative source research: Claude generation, Gemini generation, OpenAI generation, AI inference from general fragrance knowledge. The purpose of this research request is to replace AI-generated composition with externally-verified composition.
